datasets.name: Landslides dataset of the Bijie area
datasets.verbatim: The proposed RIPF-Unet model is trained and validated using the open-source landslides dataset of the Bijie area, Guizhou Province, China... To train the proposed RIPF-Unet model, an open-source dataset from the previous study (Ji et al. 2020) is used in this paper.

datasets.name: TripleSat satellite imagery of the Bijie region
datasets.verbatim: The image data were obtained from TripleSat satellite imagery of the Bijie region, Guizhou Province, China (as shown in Fig. 3a), from May to August 2018.

datasets.name: Gaofen-1 images of the Longtoushan region

methods.name: RIPF-Unet
methods.summary: A UNet-based semantic segmentation model that incorporates reversed image pyramid features (RIPFs) into the expansive path via a novel concatenation module to mitigate texture information loss caused by convolution and pooling.
methods.source: Bangjie Fu, Yange Li, Zheng Han, Zhenxiong Fang, Ningsheng Chen, Guisheng Hu, Weidong Wang

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input imagery are mentioned but not linked or made available, and the custom RIPF-Unet code is not provided.
